description: Raw historical business observations for student model development. This dataset is intentionally not cleaned, filtered, feature-engineered, labeled, or split for machine learning.
purpose: Raw production-run evidence for a capacity-constrained plant. Students must separate planned/known features from realized downtime/completion outcomes.
analysis_expectations: Which features are available before the run?
How does maintenance age relate to downtime?
When does overload make nominal capacity misleading?
How should class imbalance or line/product differences be validated?
student_warning: Do not modify the raw evidence or treat every anomaly as an error. Create derived supervised datasets and document cleaning/label assumptions.
